Package net.sf.jguiraffe.gui.builder.components.tags.table

package net.sf.jguiraffe.gui.builder.components.tags.table

A package with tag handler classes for creating table components.

With the classes stored in this package table components with all their helper objects can be created. The most important tag is represented by the TableTag class. It defines the basic structure of the table. With nested TableColumnTag tags the table's single columns can be defined. It is possible to specify special editors and renderers for the single columns of a table.
